recovery_cases_live_order_key.name: recovery_cases_live_order_key
recovery_cases_live_order_key.where: state in ('detected','diagnosed','executing','paused') and rzp_order_id is not null

recovery_cases_live_invoice_key.name: recovery_cases_live_invoice_key
recovery_cases_live_invoice_key.where: state in ('detected','diagnosed','executing','paused') and rzp_invoice_id is not null

voice_calls_unconfirmed_idx.name: voice_calls_unconfirmed_idx
voice_calls_unconfirmed_idx.where: status = 'ended' and payment_confirmed_at is null and payment_link_id is not null

abandoned_carts_pending_idx.name: abandoned_carts_pending_idx
abandoned_carts_pending_idx.where: status = 'emailed' and payment_link_id is not null and payment_confirmed_at is null
